notes: Board of Supervisors actions at a numbered street address, 1946-1966 (volumes 41-61, 22 items): the city's leases of buildings for public use (branch libraries, health centres, civil-defence warden offices, department offices, voting-machine stores), purchases and sales of buildings, works on city buildings, and zoning ordinances and appeals from the City Planning Commission. Candidates were found by a scan of every measure title in the OCR for a street number and street (scratch scripts ext4.py, body.py); each published measure was read in the text for its adoption, date and purpose. Private lessors, appellants and speakers are left out; firms and public bodies that were lessors are named; supervisors are given as vote counts.

coverage.remaining: Measures whose title gives a lot and block or a frontage but no street number (most rezonings before 1960, and much of the 1959-60 comprehensive rezoning) were not extracted. Street vacations, sidewalk permits, condemnation suits, liens, tax sales and loading zones were left out as not about a building or as naming private people. 1906-1945 unread.
coverage.note: 448 address-bearing measure titles in 22 volumes; 157 distinct addresses; the rest were loading zones, sidewalk permits, liens, condemnation suits and the like.
